clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the Deadmines, Gnoam Sprecklesprocket powers a plan to reach Gnomeregan. Shoni the Shilent seeks it for drilling machines that could breach the rock around the lost gnomish home.

Sneed's shredder runs deep in the Defias stronghold. The goblin taskmaster Sneed pilots the machine, whose compact power core supplies energy for heavy logging and cutting blades. Its steady output makes the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket valuable salvage in the tunnels of Westfall.

In Stormwind City, the gnomish inventor Shoni the Shilent has chosen the Deadmines shredder for a larger effort. Gnomish forces seek to reclaim Gnomeregan from the troggs who overran it, but sealed underground approaches block the way. Shoni plans to power heavy gyrodrillmatic excavationators with the Sprecklesprocket. They could bore through the bedrock around the lost techno-city and open an unexpected route for an underground assault.
